ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2024 first-year class; residency by known physical address): only 17 international applicants (13 admitted, 1 enrolled) and 234 other out-of-state applicants, so Farmingdale is overwhelmingly a Long Island/New York commuter college and the international admit rate rests on a tiny sample. 19% (340 students) submitted SAT and 2% (35) ACT. The GPA bands were read from the PDF text in high-to-low order and agree with the 3.27 average. No early decision/early action. Undergrad enrollment (10,007) is from College Navigator, fall 2024 (3% nonresident, no headcount).

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2024-25): nonresident tuition $17,560, required fees $1,556, food and housing on campus $16,182. These are 2024-25 figures; 2026-27 rates were not confirmed.
